rationale: Price is consolidating in the lower third of the daily range and remains firmly below both the session and 5-minute VWAPs, indicating sustained intraday seller control. The extreme compression (ATR of $0.01) signals an imminent breakout, and the path of least resistance aligns with the established downtrend toward today's low. A break below the current $14.64 support would confirm continuation, while a move above $14.68 invalidates the short thesis.
